an4.71:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni cassa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāya
an4.71:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti bahussuto hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti paññavā hoti
an4.71:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni cassa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāyāti.
